verdict.rationale: Zulip's repository ships a complete OpenAPI 3.0.1 description, "Zulip REST API", at zerver/openapi/zulip.yaml. It can be downloaded via the raw GitHub URL, and it is the primary source from which the zulip.com/api docs are generated. The probe 404s at zulip.com/openapi.json and similar paths only show the spec isn't hosted on the product domain; they don't contradict that it exists. missing for 10: spec served from a discoverable zulip.com/well-known path (all probed paths 404), independent hands-on corroboration of using the spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The zulip/zulip repository ships a complete OpenAPI 3.0.1 description of the API, info title "Zulip REST API", at zerver/openapi/zulip.yaml.
the published API docs at zulip.com/api are generated from this machine-readable spec.
